title: Terms of Service
subtitle: Guidelines and legal terms governing the use of our digital platforms.
body:
### 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing the Ronnie Care Foundation website, you agree to comply with all applicable local and international regulations.

### 2. Donations & Transparency

All donations directly support our healthcare, WASH, and educational empowerment initiatives across Nigeria. We provide full quarterly audited financial disclosures to ensure transparency.
